description: After request_api_key: picks up the API key once the person pressed Approve. Answers status "pending" while they have not (wait about 5 seconds and call again, or remind them to check their inbox), "approved" with api_key exactly once (keep it: send it in the X-API-Key header, store it as FFRAUD_API_KEY), or "denied", "expired" or "delivered" when it is over.
name: claim_api_key
title: Pick up the approved key
